evidence.why: Declares the function and the item-local three-argument callback typedef.
The custom class record uses it_MObjSetupFunc for its setup slot.
Shows callback assignment, exact definition, and absence of reads from either integer argument.

facts.rationale: Corrects the existing explanation's omission of the current three-argument item-local callback typedef while preserving cross-interface ABI uncertainty.
facts.value: The canonical definition is void(HSD_MObj* mobj, u32 rendermode_arg, u32 unused_arg), and neither incoming integer is read: effective render mode comes from mobj->rendermode. The item-local it_MObjSetupFunc typedef also has three arguments and is the declared type of it_MObjInfo.setup; initialization assigns this function through a cast to that typedef. This local declaration should be distinguished from the generic HSD material callback surface. The source establishes the item-local signature, but does not by itself settle the trailing-argument ABI at every generic dispatch site.
